entities.summary: Artur Harutyunyan is an Armenian politician from the Republic of Artsakh who served as its State Minister from 18 September 2023 to 1 January 2024. He announced his resignation as leader of the Free Homeland-UCA faction and a member of the National Assembly on 11 September 2023.
